method: Unmodified independent struct/zlib audit_one from zero-load audit, explicitly applied to three large_area DELTA runs; source files read-only; all six source hashes checked before and after.

scope_definition.full_run: complete packets wholly in each raw file; cross-file start boundaries excluded from packet statistics

limitations: Three consecutive temporal windows under one setup; not independent loading/setup trials.
ESKF cause is not encoded. q is total observed ESKF fraction only.
Elapsed time is PC packet completion time, not sensor acquisition or SCK.
Raw arrival rate window assignment cannot be reconstructed independently without read-chunk timestamps.
M1 is a communication slot, not a unique board ID. Local firmware hashes are not device-flash readback.

metadata.batch_interpretation: Temporal repeats under one setup; not independent setup blocks or automatic reloading

metadata.target_hz_source: GUI default 200 Hz; not firmware readback

module_detection_at_record.limitation: No response cannot establish whether a board is physically attached. The recent union can retain a briefly missing slot; recording freezes the set.

metadata.spi_setting_source: local firmware configuration; not measured or read back
metadata.delta_threshold_source: local firmware configuration; not measured or read back
metadata.module_identity_source: CS/IRQ slot; protocol carries no unique board identity
